highlights.excerpt:
My quick takeaways on the Anthropic S-1:

1. This is a historical moment 

2. $6.6M in revenue per employee!! Hard to even comprehend how good that is but Anthropic is AI native as it gets so makes sense. 

3. I always thought OpenAI would drop their S-1 first 

4. Customers spend about 9x more after a year.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我对 Anthropic S-1 的快速要点：

1. 这是历史性时刻

2. 人均营收 $660 万！！难想象有多强，但 Anthropic 是原生 AI 公司，说得通。

3. 我一直以为 OpenAI 会先交 S-1

4. 客户一年后花费约增至 9 倍。截至 2026-09-30，净收入留存约 900%。好的 SaaS 公司吹 120%。
highlights.name: GREG ISENBERG
highlights.text_zh: Greg：Anthropic S-1 要点——人均营收 $660 万、NRR≈900%。

highlights.excerpt:
Day 22/ Terra is back! 

Our first model that is significantly better at writing,  personality and nuanced understanding of requests.

Packs a punch across the board, very good at computer use, and gives 2X more usage than 6.1 Sol across API and subscriptions. https://t.co/1ilnCkAPuy
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Day 22/ Terra 回来了！

我们第一款在写作、个性与细腻理解请求上显著更好的模型。

全面能打，电脑操控很强，API 与订阅用量相对 6.1 Sol 翻倍。

highlights.excerpt: We're about to enter a period where not reading or writing becomes as ubiquitous as smoking once was. We can hope people will eventually realize this is bad for them, as they did with smoking. But this is far from certain; the cost may not be as obvious.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我们即将进入一个时代：不读不写会像曾经吸烟一样普遍。我们希望人们最终意识到这对自己不好，就像对吸烟那样。但这远非确定；代价可能没那么明显。
highlights.name: Paul Graham
highlights.text_zh: Paul Graham：不读不写或将像昔日吸烟一样普遍，后果未卜。

宣布三项重大科学发现，分别在数学（调和分析）、计算机科学（复杂性理论）与物理（量子场论）。

highlights.excerpt:
The Agent SDK is now available.

Define agents as code, with prompts in Markdown and tools in TypeScript. Deploy them on our hosted infrastructure, or run them on your own.

Built-in evals let you measure every change and make your agents better over time. https://t.co/sww7EXYBFI
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Agent SDK 现已可用。

用代码定义智能体：提示词写在 Markdown，工具写在 TypeScript。可部署到我们托管的基础设施，也可在自有环境运行。

内置评估让你衡量每次改动，并持续把智能体做得更好。
